newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Sevel approves global debt program.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Sevel approves global debt program.

text.p: Argentine automaker Sevel SA said Tuesday it has approved a five-year global negotiable bond program.
The company's directors approved the program which will include non-subordinated debt issues with maturities of minimum 30 days and maximum 10 years.
Sevel said in a communique to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange it will decide later on the currencies it will issue the bonds in.
The bonds may pay fixed or floating rate interest. The issues may be sold at par or at a discount, added the company.
Sevel is one Argentina's largest car producers. It makes Peugeot cars in Argentina under licence.
